current.text: Denver's projected rotation has Nikola Jokic starting at center. Valančiūnas is not listed among the five projected bench players (DeRozan, Spencer Jones, Bagley, Tyus Jones, Strawther).
Experts say backup centers in Denver historically do not produce, even ones who looked fine elsewhere. That limits his outlook behind Jokic.
Denver has a good schedule: 43 games through March 28 and only 14 back-to-backs, one of the lowest counts in the league.

durable.text: He gets very few steals. This is a weak outlier even against the whole player pool.
